matches.listing_label: Sako by Amazon Eyelet Blackout Curtains Thermal Insulated Energy Saving Curtains for Bedroom 46 x 72 Inch Light Pink Two Panels
matches.narrative: Package Detail: Two panels per package, each curtain measuring 117 x 183 cm. Sako solid blackout curtains are crafted from import premium quality soft fabric (100% Polyester). 8 sliver eyelets on the top of each curtain with 4 cm inner diameter. Perfect Blackout Performance: Advanced triple weave technology promise the nice shading effect and hang down feeling of our curtains. They will impede most of the extra sunlight and prevent your furniture from summer sun exposure to promise a longer service life. Thermal Insulation and Energy Smart: Sako thermal insulated room darkening curtains will balance your room temperature by preventing from heat escaping. They will keep heat from getting out during winter and in during summer, thereby they will save your energy bill. Home Decoration: On appearance design, we use the contracted design style. Simple designs tend to be timelessly "in", outlasting passing trends because they are the basis of good design. With elegant colors, Sako curtains will blend well with your home decor and provide comfort in style. Easy Care: Machine washable with gentle iron. Please wash in cold water.
